test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The teacher said to Anjali, “Complete your project work by tomorrow.”

options.text: The teacher told Anjali to complete your project work by tomorrow.
The teacher asked Anjali to complete her project work by tomorrow.
The teacher told Anjali to complete her project work by the following day.
The teacher told Anjali that complete your project work by the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The teacher told Anjali to complete her project work by the following day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'told'
 
• "**To**" is added to join the clause in the indirect speech when someone is giving a command to someone else.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") is replaced with the preposition 'to' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letters.
 
• The pronoun '**your**' changes to '**her**' to form the indirect speech part.
 
• **'Tomorrow' **in the direct speech becomes **'the following day'** in the indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

The indirect sentence is: *The teacher told Anjali to complete her project work by the following day.*
